messages:
sam: heads-up spotted a p99 bump on the endpoint merged tile for /v1/chat at ~14:02. p50/p95 look fine.
kevin: interesting, when I split by region the spike disappears. merged view only.
mira: could be duplicate samples (retries or fanout) getting counted multiple times into the t-digest merge. that inflates the upper tail.
jonas: yeah t-digest treats each sample as independent. duplicates biased to the right will pop p99. do we have request_id in samples?
sam: yes, payload includes request_id and a retry flag. quick ad-hoc query: `curl telemetry.internal/samples?endpoint=/v1/chat&from=1749123300&to=1749123600` shows lots of repeated request_id with retries.
kevin: two options: collapse duplicates at ingestion (permanent) or expose a query-time dedupe transform. ingestion dedupe is dangerous for historical consistency.
ux-tara: from UX POV users want endpoint percentiles to reflect a single logical request. console could default merged tiles to dedupe-by-request and show a clear provenance pill saying "dedup=request_id".
mira: agree. query-time dedupe keeps raw data intact and is reversible. perf wise grouping will add overhead though. I ran a micro-bench: grouping by request_id added ~9% CPU and ~100ms for a 200k sample query. added numbers to the draft PR.
jonas: API proposal: add `dedupe_by=(none|request_id|session_id)` and `aggregation_mode=(raw|tdigest|deduped)` to /v1/metrics/aggregate. default none. console can set deduped for merged endpoints.
kevin: also add deterministic tie-breaker rule (choose min latency per request_id) so SLOs err on the conservative side. document it in the contract.
ux-tara: small UX detail: put a "show raw" toggle on the tile so users can compare side-by-side (raw vs deduped) and trust the transform. also show expected delta if it's >5%.
telemetry-bot: :rotating_light: alert: route=/v1/chat p99 +28% vs baseline, samples=3721
sam: opened PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/1977 adds dedupe_by param + provenance header. will add tests and perf numbers.
jonas: I'll add unit tests for merge path and a synthetic harness to validate p99 collapse on duplicated high-latency samples.
mira: I'll finish the perf table and add a canary plan.
kevin: I'll draft changelog + delta-report endpoint so customers can inspect how their historical percentiles change if they enable dedupe.
sam: assigning console work to ux-tara for the provenance pill + show-raw toggle.
ux-tara: on it, will prototype by EOD.
kevin: thanks all. landing plan: (1) land API param default off, (2) console default-on for merged endpoint tiles with visible provenance and show-raw, (3) run a staged canary for 72h and publish delta report.
sam: cheers. reconvene after canary results.
